items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund that scales with valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 承諾將 5% 股份投入新公益基金，並隨估值成長擴增
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it will commit 5% of its shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a wholly-owned LLC, subject to stockholder approval. An additional 2% can be added at board discretion for every 50% increase in company value above a set baseline. Combined with prior co-founder and employee pledges, the company says roughly 20% of shares will be dedicated to public benefit.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布將把 5% 股份投入全新的 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund（全資 LLC），需股東批准。公司估值每較基準線成長 50%，董事會可酌情再增 2%。加上聯合創始人與員工既有承諾，公司表示約 20% 股份將用於公益目的。
items_flat.analysis_en: This structure directly ties Anthropic’s commercial growth to expanding public-benefit resources as a public benefit corporation, distinguishing it from typical tech equity practices. Details on governance, exact milestones, and how the fund will operate remain limited pending further disclosures.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此結構把商業成長與公益資源擴張直接掛鉤，作為公益公司有別於典型科技股權安排。治理細節、確切里程碑與實際運作方式仍待後續揭露。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Anthropic 的一部分股份投入 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund，這是一個隨著公司成長而增加持股比例的新實體。

items_flat.title_en: Meta publishes technical report on open-weight Muse Glimmer 30B for on-device agentic tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布開放權重 Muse Glimmer 30B 技術報告，主打裝置端代理任務
items_flat.summary_en: On October 19 Meta released a technical report on Muse Glimmer, its 30B open-weight model with a perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. The model is quantized to ~4-bit for single-GPU inference, accepts text and image inputs, and is released under Apache 2.0; Meta claims it leads similarly sized open models on tool use and multi-step planning.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 10 月 19 日發布 Muse Glimmer 技術報告，這是一款約 30B 參數的開放權重模型（含感知編碼器），專為消費級硬體上的自主代理任務設計。模型量化至約 4-bit 以支援單 GPU 推論，接受文字與影像輸入，以 Apache 2.0 釋出；Meta 聲稱在工具使用與多步驟規劃上領先同尺寸開放模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: An Apache 2.0 local agent model that fits on a consumer GPU lowers the barrier for private or offline agent workflows. Vendor-reported benchmarks still need independent confirmation, especially on real multi-step reliability versus larger cloud models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Apache 2.0 授權且能在消費級 GPU 上運行的本地代理模型，降低了私人或離線代理工作流的門檻。廠商自報基準仍需獨立驗證，特別是相較大型雲端模型的多步驟可靠性。
items_flat.quote: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們介紹 Muse Glimmer，一款開放原始碼的 30B 參數因果語言模型，配備感知編碼器，專為消費級硬體上的自主代理任務打造。

items_flat.title_en: MiniMax launches M3.1 Flash with claimed generational leap in agentic and coding tasks
items_flat.title_zh: MiniMax 推出 M3.1 Flash，宣稱在代理與程式任務實現代際躍進
items_flat.summary_en: MiniMax officially rolled out M3.1 Flash on October 19, describing it as a next-generation Flash model that delivers major improvements in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use, and cybersecurity, with nearly 3x faster online inference and 70% lower usage costs for agentic work. Flat pricing is $0.15 input / $0.60 output per million tokens; weights are planned for later release. The company said an earlier anonymous version (Space Bunny) had processed over 200 trillion tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: MiniMax 於 10 月 19 日正式推出 M3.1 Flash，形容其為新一代 Flash 模型，在代理任務、程式開發、Computer Use 與網路安全方面有大幅提升，線上推論速度近 3 倍、代理任務使用成本降低 70%。定價為每百萬 token 輸入 $0.15、輸出 $0.60；權重稍後釋出。公司表示先前匿名版本（Space Bunny）已處理超過 200 兆 token。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release underscores Chinese labs’ ability to deliver high agentic capability at aggressive price and speed points, potentially pressuring frontier pricing. Independent verification of the self-reported benchmarks and real-world reliability remains the key open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此釋出顯示中國實驗室能以極具競爭力的價格與速度提供高階代理能力，可能對前沿定價形成壓力。自報基準的獨立驗證與實際可靠性仍是關鍵不確定因素。
items_flat.quote: As a next-generation Flash model, M3.1 Flash delivers a generational leap in agentic tasks, coding, Computer Use and cybersecurity, while making online inference nearly three times faster and reducing usage costs by 70%.
items_flat.quote_zh: 作為新一代 Flash 模型，M3.1 Flash 在代理任務、程式開發、Computer Use 及網路安全等方面實現代際提升，同時線上推論速度提升近 3 倍，使用成本降低 70%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI highlights stronger model capabilities for low-resource languages like COBOL and Fortran
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 強調模型在 COBOL、Fortran 等低資源語言的能力提升
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI posted on October 19 that its latest model advances deliver stronger capabilities for building and migrating software in low-resource programming languages such as COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic. The company noted these languages underpin critical systems at banks, governments, and businesses, and said it is prioritizing challenges raised by developers and enterprise customers.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 19 日發文表示，最新模型進展強化了在 COBOL、Fortran、Visual Basic 等低資源程式語言上的建構與遷移能力。公司指出這些語言支撐銀行、政府與企業的關鍵系統，並表示正優先處理開發者與企業客戶提出的挑戰。
items_flat.analysis_en: Progress on legacy languages addresses a practical enterprise bottleneck where modern models have historically underperformed due to sparse training data. The absence of specific benchmark numbers or model names in the post leaves the scale of the improvement unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 對舊有語言的進展切中企業實際痛點，因訓練資料稀缺導致現代模型表現不足。貼文未提供具體基準數字或模型名稱，改善幅度仍不明朗。
items_flat.quote: Our latest model advances bring stronger capabilities for building and migrating software in low-resource programming languages such as COBOL, Fortran, and Visual Basic.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最新的模型進展，為 COBOL、Fortran 和 Visual Basic 等低資源程式語言的軟體建構與遷移帶來更強能力。

items_flat.title_en: Meta details Prometheus gigawatt-scale supercluster used to train Muse Wonder models
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 詳述用於訓練 Muse Wonder 的 Prometheus 吉瓦級超算叢集
items_flat.summary_en: Meta published an engineering post on October 19 describing Prometheus, its gigawatt-scale supercluster in New Albany, Ohio. The first phase is complete with hundreds of thousands of GPUs and was used to train Muse foundational models including Muse Wonder; the company reported >85% goodput on pre-training and >90% on RL runs, with ~47k GPU-hours mean time between interruptions.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 10 月 19 日發布工程貼文，介紹位於俄亥俄州 New Albany 的吉瓦級超算叢集 Prometheus。第一階段已完成，搭載數十萬顆 GPU，用於訓練 Muse 系列基礎模型（含 Muse Wonder）；公司報告預訓練 goodput 超過 85%、RL 超過 90%，中斷間隔約 4.7 萬 GPU 小時。
items_flat.analysis_en: Concrete reliability numbers at this scale illustrate the infrastructure engineering required to train frontier models and give context for Meta’s recent Muse Wonder claims. Full capacity toward ~1 million GPUs remains a stated goal rather than a completed milestone.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此規模的具體可靠性數據，說明訓練前沿模型所需的基礎設施工程，也為 Meta 近期 Muse Wonder 主張提供背景。朝向約 100 萬 GPU 的完整容量仍是目標而非已完成里程碑。
items_flat.quote: The first phase has already been completed and was used to train our Muse foundational models, including the Muse Wonder models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 第一階段已完成，並用於訓練我們的 Muse 基礎模型，包括 Muse Wonder 模型。
